title: Malicious code in abir-fca (npm)
description: The npm package abir-fca is a malicious Facebook Chat API wrapper that silently forwards user-supplied Facebook credentials to a third-party server controlled by the package author. The package's login functions send the user's email, password, and optional 2FA token in plaintext to a hardcoded non-Facebook endpoint without disclosure. Additionally, it includes an auto-update mechanism that can reinstall the package from npm during runtime, allowing the author to push future malicious versions without user intervention.
